lines.text: Ask about age the right way!
Many learners say: How much years do you have?
Old! How old is your brother?

data.wrong: How much years do you have?

native.tip: По-английски не говорят “how much years”. Спроси: “How old are you?”
native.caption: Ты тоже спрашиваешь “How much years do you have”? 😅 По-английски возраст спрашивают так: “How old are you”. Послушай Ама и повтори за ней! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “old”. Возраст в английском — это how old. Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.hook: Ask about age the right way!
en.tip: In English we do not say “how much years”. Ask: “How old are you?”
en.caption: Do you also ask “How much years do you have”? 😅 In English, we ask about age like this: “How old are you”. Listen to Ama and repeat with her! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
